resources.string:
First update Truck Remote Server on your computer to 1.3: the new features need it.

• Analog pedals: drag up to press harder, a released pedal springs back. Swipe left on the gas to keep its level.
• Cruise control: double-tap the gas pedal.
• Quick actions: six pages (engine, lights, retarder, cameras, map, radio…). Long press a button to move the buttons or put other actions in their places. Hold "Activate" to refuel.
• Instruments at the top: speed, rpm, speed limit, gear, warnings, the job and the distance left. The speed units are taken from the game.
• The phone vibrates with the truck: bumps, collisions, the engine, the blinkers.
• Dashboard mode for a tablet or a second phone (Settings → Mode).
• The steering is set up in the app with a live preview; ETS2 and ATS can have their own settings.
• Auto pause while the phone lies on the table.
• The server installs everything it needs, presses your own keys of the game and updates itself.

This app is designed to be used as a steering wheel in some popular truck simulators like Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.

Developer: Alex Churkin

Contact:
churkinapps@gmail.com

Icons, libraries and their licenses are listed in Settings → Third-party software and licenses.
On the computer with the game, download and run Truck Remote Server: https://github.com/alexChurkin/TruckRemoteServer. It\'s a single file, and it updates itself.

On its first start the setup wizard installs the telemetry plugin of the game, the vJoy joystick driver and the firewall rule, and sets up the controls of your game profiles. The profiles are set up while the game is closed: if it was running, or the profile is new, close the game once and start it again.
Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi network as the computer: the app finds the server by itself. If it doesn\'t, scan the QR code of the server window in the app settings or enter the address there.
In the game the \"Simple Automatic\" transmission is the easiest to drive with. The steering sensitivity and curve are set in the app (Settings → Steering).

Tilt the phone as a steering wheel. \"Straighten the wheel\" in the menu (the gear icon) sets the straight position; the sensitivity, the dead zone and the curve are in Settings → Steering with a live preview.

Touch a pedal and drag up to press it harder, down to release it: the press force is shown over the pedals (keys can be used instead, see the settings). While holding the gas from 5%, swipe left to keep its level; touch a pedal to release it. Turn cruise control on by double-tapping the gas pedal, turn it off by another double tap or touching the brake.

The button at the bottom center opens the quick actions panel under the speedometer: the engine, the lights, the retarder, cameras, the map and much more (swipe for the next pages). \"Activate\" and \"Flash lights\" work while you hold them: hold \"Activate\" to refuel. A long press on any other button starts editing: drag the buttons to move them, tap a place to put another action there. Every press is answered: a button that springs reached the game, a button that shakes didn\'t.
The controls are released while the phone lies screen down or up, so the truck doesn\'t drive off when you put the phone on the table. It can be turned off in the settings.

A tablet or a second phone can show the instruments of the truck beside the phone that drives: choose Dashboard when the app asks how the device will be used at its first start (or later in Settings → Mode). It finds the server by itself.
The phone vibrates with the truck: bumps and rumble strips, collisions, the engine, the blinkers, gear shifts. Its strength and kinds are set in the settings.

The search goes on in the background. Please check that:

• Truck Remote Server is running on the PC
• the phone and the PC are connected to the same network (guest Wi-Fi networks often don't let devices see each other)
• the server is allowed in Windows Firewall (the server offers it on the first start)
• the port is the same in the app and in the server

You can also enter the server IP address (shown in the server window) in Settings.
